info.title: MICROSERVICE-development-billing-dotnet-api-Replace Api Session By Session Id-v1-spec
info.description: The Session Management API enables businesses to effectively replace session details using a unique session ID. This operation supports the modification of existing session attributes, ensuring seamless user experiences and system integrity. Typical consumers include application developers and integration teams who require dynamic session handling functionality. The API is essential for applications with user session management needs, allowing for flexible updates to session data without disrupting ongoing processes.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to modify the details of a specific session identified by its ID. It enables adjustments to the session's attributes, enhancing the flexibility and management of session data.

requestBody.description: This request body updates the session with the specified ID. It must follow the defined schema and include all necessary fields to successfully modify the session data.
